newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Bank says board authorizes div.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Bank says board authorizes div.

text.p: Peoples Bank said on Tuesday that its directors had voted to authorize a 10 percent stock dividend payable May 16 to shareholders of record May 1.
Current shares outstanding amount to 1,547,483, the company said in a statement.

The bank also said its total assets at the end of the first quarter were $286.4 million, an increase of 20 percent compared to last year's figure. Book value per share amounted to $14.78 as of March 31, the company said, representing an increase of 4 percent over the same period in 1996.

Peoples Bank operates eight financial service offices in the Catawba and Alexander counties. The bank will open its ninth office in Denver, N.C., in June and has recently received regulatory approval to establish a branch in the Viewmont neighborhood of Hickory, the company said.
